categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Modifies CreateNewBlock() logging in src/node/miner.cpp and updates test/functional/mining_basic.py.
categories.rationale: Silencing unconditional CreateNewBlock() log lines resolves debug.log spam for operators generating frequent templates (#36334), but has no effect on template validity, accounting, or mining performance.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Labeled Utils/log/libs and modifies src/logging.cpp and src/logging/categories.h to introduce a new logging category.
categories.rationale: Introducing a -debug=mining category solves a concrete user complaint about debug.log spam (#36334) caused by frequent block template creation. Reviewers noted that adding a dedicated category for a single log line may be excessive compared to reusing an existing one.
